body:
Everything so far is debug APKs (debuggable, unminified, carries the TLS-bypass
toggle). For daily use: create a signing keystore (document handling), verify R8/
minification doesn't break kotlinx-serialization (usually needs keep rules — a
classic silent release-only crash), run the testRelease suite (exists since T-46),
build and on-device-test a release APK. Check the manifest/gradle for
minifyEnabled/shrinkResources decisions.
title: Android release build: keystore, R8/kotlinx-serialization keep rules, release APK
